novelty: No hostname match in 83 available historical job receipts or current living handoff; not proof of global model-training novelty. Public directory/search-based selection; product accessibility and suitability not pretested.

protocol.submission: URL only via verified deployed private POST /v1/jobs. No manual actions, accounts, selectors, plans, site hints, uploads, or new permissions. Existing guardrails remain.
protocol.freeze: All 20 URLs and their order fixed before first submission. One engine code/config snapshot per run; record actual service PID, commit and flags at submission. Never mix revisions in one aggregate; if concurrent deployment changes executable code or flags, stop this run and mark remaining pending. No tuning on holdout, no feeding its outputs into prompts or few-shot references. Develop on development cohort; any holdout used for tuning is retired and a fresh independent cohort is required.
protocol.capacity: At most two admitted jobs in flight; use existing API admission limits. Queue-full is not an admitted product attempt. Record and stop on uncertain admission; never blindly retry. No new infrastructure or unbounded inference. First pass one admitted job per URL; internal existing revision allowed and counted.
protocol.denominator: 20 fixed products; discovery rejection, access block, unsupported interaction, capture/render failure and creative rejection are not successes. Report pending separately; never extrapolate partial results. Public/demo surfaces may be synthetic; label source honestly.
metrics: creative critic decision and score where available, not human approval
independent owner publishability review, source truth, readability, action-first framing, pacing
signed playable review link and exact SHA256
protocol.acceptance: Human approval only, >=85/100 target and all source/craft gates; no automatic release. No scoring based solely on passing tests. All failures remain in denominator. Re-evaluation on the same cohort is a regression set, not a new unseen benchmark.
